Formulation
Patient presents with numbness and tingling in the left arm, possibly linked to starting a boxing class, alongside a transient episodes of visual disturbance. Lifestyle factors such as rigorous exercise and social partying may contribute to stress and fatigue. Family history indicates possible autoimmune and metabolic conditions that may predispose to similar symptoms. Primary goal is ruling out or diagnosing potential neurological conditions such as MS.

- Patient Goal(s): Determine the cause of symptoms and receive appropriate treatment
- Clinical Goal(s): Rule out or diagnose MS; address neurological symptoms
- Actions (Patient): Monitor symptoms; report worsening to physician or emergency services as instructed
